lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are distributed across the central flank. These local maxima are arranged in roughly horizontal rows, with significant clusters located posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a localized grid-like appearance across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple horizontal linear features are visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced low intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin in the lower foreground exhibits a high-density distribution of small, circular white spots that appear more concentrated and smaller in diameter compared to the primary flank constellation.
